analysis: The two supplied units (CHANGELOG.md base_text lines 3959-4638) are unchanged historical release-note prose from the base side. The only changed range is in the head at lines 11-333, a v0.10.8 candidate section and its rollout notes, which is not in the supplied units. Only a truncated patch excerpt of that range was available. The excerpt describes pair-update behavior: both Macs must run the same build, the pair's update installs on both or neither, auto_update is on by default, and pair approvals are capped at 64 per release. The text is documentation only. It changes no code, no trust boundary, no keys, no attestation and no cache storage logic. The base-side historical content mentions earlier security-relevant changes: inline video kept off disk, retirement of provider free-form telemetry, and the runtime manifest union semantics. These are pre-existing, and I saw no regression or invalidated assumption in what was supplied. T-041 and related prefix-cache entries are not changed by anything visible. Remaining uncertainty: the full v0.10.8 section (head lines 11-333) was not visible, so any security-relevant claims in it, such as pairing, cluster services, coordinator pair-approval limits or update behavior, could not be checked. If the underlying PR includes code for the two-Mac cluster pairing and update flow, that code and the threat model need a separate review. Nothing in the supplied units supports a finding.
